Definition: a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth
BiblicalUsage: Beerothite — an inhabitant of Beeroth — it shows up 5 times, including 2 Samuel 4:2.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beerothite shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
